Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by insider warnings and Fed hawkishness on inflation. This creates headwinds for your tech/chip names, especially with margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.27%) and SPAL (-60.72%) are deep in the red and leveraged; their default stops are unhelpful. SMH (-15.16%) and QQQI (-6.83%) are both very close to their stops. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Fed commentary and how your leveraged ETFs react to market shifts.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and stop-loss discipline, especially on your most volatile and leveraged positions.
plays: Adjust stops for SOXL and SPAL to reflect current prices and manage deep losses on these leveraged ETFs.
Watch SMH and QQQI closely; consider trimming if they break their respective 540 and 52 stops.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
